description: Company-level profile for a Norwegian organisation number (9 digits; 'NO 123 456 789 MVA' accepted): name, legal form, NACE code, municipality, status, bankruptcy/liquidation flags. Company-level data only: sole proprietorships (ENK) are withheld; no roles/persons, no street addresses, e-mail or phone. Source: Brreg Enhetsregisteret (NLOD 2.0).
name: brreg_company_lookup
title: Norwegian company lookup (Brreg)
